about: '99Vidas' is a brawler set in a contemporary world, but that pays tribute to both the classic and the new in the gaming industry. Brought to you in 16-bit pixelated glory, chock-full of references to not only gaming but also 80's and 90's pop culture. '99Vidas' takes full advantage modern era gameplay mechanics, making it the best of both worlds.
• Up to 4 player co-op across the PS4™ & PS3™ systems
• Cross-Play across the PS4™ and PS3™ systems
summary: '99Vidas' is a brawler set in a contemporary world, but that pays tribute to both the classic and the new in the gaming industry.
